description: SIDE EFFECT, MAY SPEND MONEY: buys a Mike Fluff Press book for the person signed in with INITE ID. Books are bought into an INITE account (the reader unlocks paid chapters for the account that paid), so this needs the person: OAuth scope "mikefluff:purchase"; without a token it is answered with HTTP 401 and the client signs the person in. If the person has allowed this shop to charge their INITE wallet, the book is paid at once within the limit they set. If not, the result is one link for the person: there they pay this time and, if they like, allow such payments from now on. Failing both, a payment link (card, PIX). An agent signed in as itself (client_credentials, its own did:web) buys under its own account and pays the returned x402Url from its INITE wallet (pay tool at billing.inite.ai/mcp/wallet). If they already own the book it says so instead. Only call when the user has asked to buy this book.

email.description: Optional: the user's email, for the receipt when the account has none.

locale.description: Language of the book page and currency of the price.

name: buy_book
